After the infection has progressed to the point of victim going feral and not hiding their condition, why bother with rape to infect victims?

You'd think blood-saliva or blood-blood(SPIDER EBOLA) contact via assault would more selectively favored behavior than risking a prolonged struggle snuggle. It's infectious enough to spread out of a petri dish after all

item.content:encoded: There are more hormones that affect the sex drive than testosterone, but partly due to Western cultural factors, testosterone is by far the best understood, so many people - including doctors and scientists - get lazy and assume it's the only thing that affects it (they see T increase and don't bother looking for much else). Does this … thing … increase estrogen levels in females on stage 6?
Because if it would supply testosterone to a woman, we'd get a hairy muscled woman. Who'd want to breed with that?

Not necessarily. It really depends on how much additional testosterone is produced. A slight increase may not cause any noticable difference in hair growth for a while.

Though that is one thing I do raise my eyebrow at a little bit. Maybe this thing could affect more hormones then just testosterone to limit that effect.

Either way, the thought of this moving among us is distrubing to say the least.
